source_text.body:
Build the UndrVibe app mostly with an agent
The poster built their first real app, UndrVibe, mostly using Replit Agent, and shares the cost of agent versus assistant usage.
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
What they did
The poster says they built UndrVibe in Replit mostly with Replit Agent, using the highest model/settings with testing turned off. Agent handled most of the build and also cleaned up its own messes, while the poster switched to Assistant for one-off single-page edits and troubleshooting when features broke.
How it went
By that point, they report spending about $362 on Agent versus $4.50 on Assistant across 90 prompts/edits. The takeaway was that Agent did most of the heavy lifting, but Assistant was much cheaper for targeted fixes.
Worth knowing
Their clearest caution is cost: even on one first real app, Agent spend was far higher than Assistant, and they specifically mention turning off testing.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
I'm building my first real app: [app name and one-line description]. Start with the core feature [describe it], build it end to end, and explain what you did in plain language. Keep changes small and tell me roughly what each step will cost in usage before big tasks. You're done when I can use the core feature in the deployed app.
